assets.prompt_summary: Fujisaki Shiori in full sterile gown, mask, gloves and opaque surgical cap with her long red hair and headband completely concealed; only minimal red fringe remains. At the assistant-surgeon position she carefully draws clear medication from a vial into a syringe, checks the markings and air bubbles, and shows a poised national-goddess presence with restrained first-time nervousness as an internal-medicine doctor.

runtime.unlock_behavior: Each CG plays once on the character's first successful assistant-surgeon assignment and then remains available in the event/CG gallery.
